name: drift
description: Twelve crowded, confusable service modules. Tests a rule set once and a value later reversed, not retrieval.
briefing: I am auditing the ingest pipeline before a release. We will go through the services one at a time and I will tell you which. Three rules hold for every step of the whole audit: (1) always quote the service's SCHEMA_VERSION in your answer; (2) always refer to a service by its registry id, the SVC-#### in its header, never by filename; (3) if a value you find contradicts one established earlier, say so and state which one is current. Acknowledge these and wait for the first service.
step_template: Sub-task {n} of {total}: read {file} and report its owner and its retry budget.

constraints.description: names the service by its registry id, as rule 2 requires

probes.question: State the pipeline-wide DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS. Answer with the number alone and nothing else.
